text:
A Special Weather Statement is posted this morning, so check the latest alert before heading out. If your plans start early, give the fog a little time to lift, then expect a pleasant, mostly sunny day with a high right around 78 and barely any wind. The lake will be calm, with waves a foot or less, but morning visibility could be poor near the waterfront. Water temperatures are a comfortable 71.

Tonight turns cloudier, with showers possible after midnight. Tuesday looks cooler and less settled, mostly cloudy with a chance of light showers and a high somewhere in the low to mid 70s. The models disagree on both the temperature and how widespread the rain gets, so I’d keep outdoor plans flexible rather than cancel them outright. Wednesday is the bigger concern, with the potential for locally heavy rain and thunderstorms. Enjoy the dry window today, and plan to be off the lake before Tuesday’s showers become an issue.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Showers were quite light today, so it was still reasonably decent for the Champlain Valley Fair. A few showers and possible thunderstorms will move through the Northeast Kingdom this evening, then it will be partly cloudy overnight. Lows will be in the 40s and 50s.
